config.features: RAW mean embeddings (NO perlang_z / no L2 / no z-score)
config.sweep_axis: decision-score percentile q=0..100 (see decision_score kinds); 0 = predict all positive, larger q = stricter

XGBoost.note: XGBoost binary:logistic, hist, max_bin=64, cpu, n_jobs=2, seed=0, depth=8, mcw=5, lr=0.1, n=400 (identical to toxi_pr_all.py); score = predict_proba[:,1]

SVC_linear.note: liblinear PRIMAL linear SVM (fast equivalent of SVC(kernel='linear')); score = decision_function (margin)

KNeighborsClassifier.note: k=5 (default), n_jobs=2; score = CONTINUOUS distance-weighted positive fraction (1/(d+eps) weights over the 5 NN) -- NOT the 6-valued discrete predict_proba

GaussianNB.note: sklearn defaults; score = log-likelihood-ratio predict_log_proba[:,1]-predict_log_proba[:,0] (continuous, not saturated)

config.val_threshold_rule: F1-optimal on the model's own-language validation split, searched over the validation score's percentiles (raw threshold stored)
config.svc_linear_note: plain libsvm SVC(kernel='linear') is infeasible at n=24k x 768 (>11 min/fit, non-convergent); used the liblinear PRIMAL linear SVM LinearSVC(loss='squared_hinge', dual=False) as its fast equivalent, scored by decision_function.
config.note: 210m curves are solid, 610m curves are dotted in the per-model figures. The deliverable grids are two separate figures (Precision and Recall), each with columns = backbones, so within-cell solid/dotted is meaningless there.
